name: QBITFLOW
description: QBITFLOW is a Bremen-based spin-off of the University of Bremen's ZARM institute that develops modular ultra-high-vacuum (UHV) systems and components for cold-atom quantum sensors, drawing on its founders' experience with quantum sensors for space missions. It is an incubatee of ESA BIC Northern Germany and also offers practical quantum-sensor training for technical teams.

products.name: Modular UHV system
products.description: Modular, turn-key ultra-high-vacuum systems and components for cold-atom, ion-trap and other vacuum-dependent quantum experiments

highlights: Spin-off of the University of Bremen's ZARM institute, founded 2022
Incubated at ESA BIC Northern Germany since 2025
